summary: A refreshed interface, compact transfer views, and safer imports and recovery.

items.text: Search app pages and settings with recent queries and clear history.
Cloud services dashboard for B2 and OneDrive accounts.
Searchable source and destination pickers for local and cloud transfers.
Guided transfer exclusions with editable rules and example matching.
System, Light and Dark theme previews with Windows appearance shortcuts.
Fixed unnecessary stacking and cramped controls in smaller windows.
Fixed navigation unexpectedly returning Home or losing the current settings page.
Fixed transfer-row and tray crashes caused by icon recycling.
Prevented damaged or inaccessible diagnostic files from blocking startup.
Restored independent cloud-job pause/resume without a configured B2 backup.
Corrected startup controls and pause state for OneDrive-only accounts.
Preserved transfer drafts when connecting an account during setup.
Fixed folder moves failing after verified child files were removed.
Rejected stale import reviews and guarded source files against concurrent changes.
Preserved read-only imports and destination conflicts; kept online-only previews from downloading file contents.
Fixed native sync-root registration in the Store package.
Prevented missing placeholders after Store removal from propagating cloud deletions during recovery.
Corrected folder-icon scaling and caption colors when Windows and app themes differ.
Refreshed Fluent pages, navigation, icons, dialogs and tray.
Combined transfer status, speed, progress and size into compact rows.
Simplified Updates messages and grouped actions into a wrapping toolbar.
Adapted theme previews to available width and text scaling.
Improved OneDrive sign-in with code, expiry, progress and copy controls.
Adapted minimum window sizing to display scale and available screen space.
Future releases use CloudInlet packages and schema-2 updates; original CloudBay clients upgrade through the frozen 1.1.2 bridge. Existing installation paths and saved data are preserved.
Windows 11 Store virtualization exclusions now cover only shared app state and required Explorer settings; data-retention and uninstall guidance are documented.
Updated SQLite bundle to 2.1.13, with SQLite engine 3.53.3.
Strengthened package validation, final checksums and release-file handling.

installationNotes: **Platform:** x64. The package minimum is Windows 10 build 19041; local native validation covered Windows 11. Windows 10 execution remains unverified.
**Runtime:** bundled with the app; no separate .NET installation is required.
Keep the same installer type and Release/Debug build when updating.
Original CloudBay installations must upgrade through the **1.1.2 bridge** first.
Portable builds update manually; Store installations update through Microsoft Store.
GitHub's source archives are for building the app.

items: 959 local desktop tests and 116 release-script assertions passed for this release.
Light and dark UI checks, including compact-window layouts; isolated Store-package removal and recovery checks.
Hosted tests exclude Native and LiveProvider cases. Live B2/OneDrive acceptance and real personal-folder redirection remain unverified. Store certification is separate.
